2 · Paste the post copy

Flights within Alaska kept flying on November 13th while every flight leaving the state was grounded.

So said an Anchorage airport official. The FAA's nationwide stop ran 11:54 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. Alaska time.

By mid-afternoon Cirium counted 670 flights sent back and 157 redirected nationwide. Three days earlier SMART, the FAA's AI traffic advisor, went national. The FAA blamed a router overloading older equipment. SMART's maker says the stop wasn't a result of its system.

The carousel shows the stop minute by minute, the national toll, SMART's rollout, the stated cause and Anchorage Center's airspace.

Should the next federal dollar go to the AI the FAA credits with 10 minutes per reroute or to the older equipment a router overloaded?

#AlaskaAviation #AirTrafficControl #AviationAI

Editor's note

Ships at 8.47 against the 4-round threshold of 7.7 (cycle 1 was 8.40 against 8.0), zero hard fails. Artwork craft is 7.0, under the 8.5 craft floor; the one owed craft cycle ran (07, 09, 01, 06, 05) and helped 06 and 07 but left the dark box behind the plate on the cover (01) and the close (09), which the scorer calls the most visible defect at thumb size. Slide 08's rider THE RECORD DOES NOT SAY WHETHER SMART RUNS HERE is deliberate: no fetched source places Anchorage Center among the 22 SMART centers. The 670 and 157 are Cirium's nationwide counts at one moment. 4:15 p.m. AKST is the conversion of NBC's 8:15 p.m. ET.
This edition picks up from No.36 (August 18th), which introduced SMART and Alaska Airlines' Flyways; this one covers the November 10th nationwide switch on and the November 13th ground stop. No fetched source places Anchorage Center among the 22 SMART centers, so the caption, the slides and the sources comment never say SMART runs over Alaska. The 4:15 p.m. Alaska time is the conversion of the FAA's 8:15 p.m. Eastern lift as NBC News reported it. 261 minutes (11:54 a.m. to 4:15 p.m. AKST) and 827 flights (670 plus 157) are declared aggregates of sourced figures, re-derived by aggregate_check. The 670 and the 157 are Cirium's nationwide counts at one moment in the midafternoon, not Alaska counts. Session effort read medium, although the repo settings carry high.
